facts.fact: The FY2025/26 estimates allocate BWP 3,950,000 to the Ministry of Higher Education's development project 12601 MHE Computerisation, funded from the Domestic Development Fund.

facts.fact: Actual expenditure on project 12601 was BWP 3,950,000 at 5 December 2025, 100 percent of the appropriation; a part-year cut-off.
